title: Bad years before the war and being drafted again at 44
summary: Music slumped before the war, Hall worked a five-piece band at Strip City, and was drafted a second time at age 44.

blocks.x: Cure or so. Yeah, because, and then after that, when things got, just before the war I think it was, things got pretty bad around there for music. Yeah, I remember that. Yeah. So.
